name: optimize_csharp_string_concat_stringbuilder
description: Optimizes O(n^2) string building (+= in a loop) to a single-pass StringBuilder
prompts:
Report.Build(IReadOnlyList<string> lines) in Report.cs joins the lines into one string, appending each line followed by '
'. It accumulates with `result += line + "
"` inside the loop; because .NET strings are immutable, each += copies the entire growing string, making the whole thing O(n^2) and far too slow for tens of thousands of lines. Rewrite Build to run in linear time using System.Text.StringBuilder (append each line and a '
'), producing exactly the same string (every line followed by a newline, in order). Keep the class name and the Build(IReadOnlyList<string>) signature.

setup_files.app.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- tests/ has its own project; without this the SDK's default glob
         compiles tests/*.cs into the app itself, where xunit isn't referenced -->
    <Compile Remove="tests/**" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
